q.en: Which level of teaching is primarily concerned with problem-solving and critical reflection?
q.hi: Which level of teaching is primarily concerned with problem-solving and critical reflection?

explanation.en: The reflective level encourages critical thinking, independent judgement and solving unfamiliar problems.
explanation.hi: चिंतनशील स्तर आलोचनात्मक सोच, स्वतंत्र निर्णय और नई समस्याओं के समाधान को बढ़ावा देता है।

q.en: Which assessment is conducted during the teaching-learning process to improve learning?
q.hi: Which assessment is conducted during the teaching-learning process to improve learning?

explanation.en: Formative assessment provides ongoing feedback while instruction is in progress.
explanation.hi: रचनात्मक मूल्यांकन शिक्षण के दौरान निरंतर प्रतिक्रिया देकर सीखने में सुधार करता है।

q.en: A hypothesis stating that there is no significant difference between two groups is called:
q.hi: A hypothesis stating that there is no significant difference between two groups is called:

explanation.en: The null hypothesis (H0) generally states that no effect, association or difference exists.
explanation.hi: शून्य परिकल्पना (H0) सामान्यतः प्रभाव, संबंध या अंतर न होने का कथन है।

q.en: Which sampling method gives every unit in the population an equal chance of selection?
q.hi: Which sampling method gives every unit in the population an equal chance of selection?

explanation.en: In simple random sampling, each population unit has an equal and independent chance of selection.
explanation.hi: सरल यादृच्छिक प्रतिचयन में समष्टि की प्रत्येक इकाई के चुने जाने की समान संभावना होती है।

q.en: Read the passage: 'Open access expands the reach of scholarly work, but quality assurance still depends on rigorous peer review.' What is the central idea?
q.hi: Read the passage: 'Open access expands the reach of scholarly work, but quality assurance still depends on rigorous peer review.' What is the central idea?

en: Open access removes the need for peer review
Wider access and quality review are both important
All open-access work is automatically reliable
hi: Open access removes the need for peer review
Wider access and quality review are both important
All open-access work is automatically reliable

explanation.en: The sentence supports wider access while retaining rigorous peer review as a quality safeguard.
explanation.hi: वाक्य व्यापक पहुँच का समर्थन करता है, साथ ही गुणवत्ता के लिए कठोर सहकर्मी समीक्षा को आवश्यक मानता है।

example.en: Both access and quality assurance matter.

q.en: In the Shannon-Weaver model, which component represents interference in message transmission?
q.hi: In the Shannon-Weaver model, which component represents interference in message transmission?

explanation.en: Noise is any interference that distorts or obstructs the transmission of a message.
explanation.hi: Noise वह व्यवधान है जो संदेश के संप्रेषण को विकृत या बाधित करता है।

example.en: A loud sound during a lecture
example.hi: व्याख्यान के दौरान तेज बाहरी आवाज

q.en: A number is increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%. What is the net change?
q.hi: A number is increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%. What is the net change?

explanation.en: Take 100: after a 20% increase it becomes 120; a 20% decrease gives 96. Net change = 4% decrease.
explanation.hi: 100 मानें: 20% वृद्धि के बाद 120; फिर 20% कमी पर 96। कुल परिवर्तन 4% की कमी है।

q.en: In Indian logic, inference is known as:
q.hi: In Indian logic, inference is known as:

explanation.en: Anumana is knowledge obtained through inference, based on a recognised relation such as vyapti.
explanation.hi: अनुमान वह ज्ञान है जो व्याप्ति जैसे मान्य संबंध के आधार पर निष्कर्ष से प्राप्त होता है।

example.en: Smoke indicates fire when the relation is established.
example.hi: व्याप्ति स्थापित होने पर धुआँ अग्नि का संकेत देता है।

q.en: The Montreal Protocol primarily addresses the depletion of:
q.hi: The Montreal Protocol primarily addresses the depletion of:

explanation.en: The Montreal Protocol controls ozone-depleting substances to protect the stratospheric ozone layer.
explanation.hi: मॉन्ट्रियल प्रोटोकॉल समतापमंडलीय ओजोन परत की रक्षा हेतु ओजोन-क्षयकारी पदार्थों को नियंत्रित करता है।

q.en: The University Grants Commission (UGC) was established by an Act of Parliament in:
q.hi: The University Grants Commission (UGC) was established by an Act of Parliament in:

explanation.en: The UGC became a statutory body through the UGC Act, 1956. It had earlier been inaugurated in 1953.
explanation.hi: UGC अधिनियम, 1956 के माध्यम से UGC वैधानिक संस्था बना। इसका उद्घाटन 1953 में हुआ था।
